hwe_bench.problem_statement:
## Description
The bug is in the OpenTitan ENTROPY_SRC (Entropy Source) IP's hardware-conditioned FIPS seed generation path, specifically the handoff from the health-test completion logic to the SHA3 conditioner when `RNG_BIT_ENABLE` selects a single RNG lane. In this mode, the completion of a health-test window can be signaled before the final word from that window has been accepted from the pre-conditioner FIFO.

## Affected Function
The affected logic is the ENTROPY_SRC main state machine and SHA3 conditioning interface that convert health-tested raw entropy into a conditioned seed output in single-lane FIPS operation.

## Expected Behavior
When ENTROPY_SRC is generating hardware-conditioned FIPS seeds from a single RNG lane, SHA3 must not start processing until every word belonging to the completed health-test window has been accepted from the pre-conditioner FIFO. The resulting conditioned seed must therefore be derived from the entire completed window, including its final word.

## Actual Behavior
In single-lane mode, the health-test completion pulse can arrive one cycle too early. This causes SHA3 `process_i` to assert before the last word from the pre-conditioner FIFO has been absorbed. Once `process_i` is asserted, SHA3 stops accepting new input words, so the final word of the completed window is omitted and the resulting conditioned seed no longer matches the expected seed for that window.

## Trigger Condition
The failure occurs when ENTROPY_SRC is configured for FIPS hardware conditioning with `RNG_BIT_ENABLE` selecting one of the four RNG lanes, and a health-test window completes while the final pre-conditioner FIFO word for that window is still being handed to SHA3. Under that boundary condition, the conditioned seed output is generated from incomplete input data and can mismatch.

reduction.limitations: Reauthored interface and minimal environment isolate one contract; this does not reproduce upstream integration, performance, or full regression behavior.
reduction.preserved_contract: Pulse process_o only when the word marked window_last_i completes a word_valid_i/word_ready_i handshake.
reduction.preserved_mechanism: A health-test window completion could start conditioning before its final FIFO word had actually been accepted.
